chapter: Favorite bands, advice and family reflections
title: Great-grandfather Tom Lewis and family records
summary: Eutris recalls her great-grandfather, born in slavery but never a slave, and the Bible with family names.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: So you said that those were your earliest recollections?

Yeah and my great grandfather's name was Tom. I can remember now. His name was Tom Lewis and he had a son named Robin Lewis, that was my mother's father. Grandpa Tom had several boys. I don't know how many girls he had but one of the boys' name was Robin and that was my mother's father.
One named Ed because I can remember my mother used to call Uncle Ed.
Yes. So my grandfather's son ... (several of them) He was born in slavery, I remember that, but he was never a slave. He wasn't a slave. ... they

say he had indian blood in him. And he had a big plantation, they a team of horses and he had about seven sons and xxx all were big, strapping young men. So, they grew up and my grandfather lived to the ripe old age, I remember when he died and I remember what happened to my grandfather after all of the, I mean my great grandfather, Uncle Tom, I remember what happened to him. But, he was never, he was born in slavery but he wasn't a slave for some reason, I don't know why. I think he must have been part indian. maybe

Or maybe where he was born, or something like that. I mean like most people think that all black people were slaves and the truth of the matter is that they weren't. I mean a great deal in the South and all over weren't. Tell me do you know approximately when he was born?
No, I don't. It was a long time ago.
died when was a baby, you know, my great grandfather. And his son died when ...
I don't know. My grandfather was dead when I was born. ...
Are there Were they any papers or documents still floating around ...
The tree that you have up in your house, the family tree, the Orange tree, was there one ever drawn up for the Higginbotham family?
No, that's from the Orange family.
I know. I said was there ever one drawn up that you know of?
The only thing we have is the Bible, you know all of the names in the back, our family.

Yes, they did but something got lost or misplaced, you know, when they were moving around. There were 14 children in the family. Six girls and eight boys in the family when we came along and J. C. the and/other boy. Another one came after they were born.
